annotations.title: Read a run's status and results

description: Without execution_id: the paid data capabilities this workspace can run, each with its providers and exact prices. With execution_id: that run's state, attempts and exact cost, settled once in the ledger when final; with results true, its rows and provenance (include_raw true adds the provider's own answer). Generated images and audio come as a signed link (media_url, valid for days) with their type and size; a small one is also attached as an image or audio block. A long result answers as many rows as fit and says the offset that reads the rest. NOT for: finding a task or tool to run, which is capability_search.

full_text.description: With results: answer long text values whole. By default a result of several rows cuts each text value at 4000 characters and lists the cut fields in that row's truncated_fields.

include_raw.description: With results: also include the winning provider's own answer (raw) and the normalised output. Large and repeats the rows; leave it out unless the rows lack a field you need.

max_items.description: With results: the max_items the run was started with, so the answer can say when the rows stopped at that limit. run_capability's next names it.

offset.description: With results: the first row to answer (0-based), from next_offset when a long result did not fit in one answer. Default 0.

name: capability_run_status
